column1: # Rare variant graphs kept by the CMETA editions (數位中醫校書郎, collated against the images), each mapped to the
# standard character the other transcriptions of the same work write in its place.  Derived by aligning every CMETA
# edition with a transcription of its work in the store (宋本伤寒论, 金匮, 素问, 灵枢, 名医类案, 古今医案按) and kept
# where all aligned occurrences (at least two) agree; reviewed.  Graphs that the corpus also uses as words of their
# own (㕮 in 㕮咀, 𫈟, 𫏋 …) are not mapped.
# columns: variant, normalised form, source, aligned occurrences
